# Pull request

## What

What this change does.

## Why

The problem it solves or the reason for it.

## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the added or fixed behaviour
- [ ] A new decoder of app or archive input ships a fuzz target
- [ ] Every commit carries a `Signed-off-by` trailer (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] A change to behaviour changes the document that describes it
- [ ] A change to `PinSHA256` in `internal/qt` states the new checksum
- [ ] No gate was weakened to pass
